data.text:
IN PHOTOS: Kowloon House workers hold a protest and strike vote referendum outside their West Avenue branch in Quezon City on April 8, 2026, amid a dispute with management over wage compliance, including disagreements on adjustments and alleged deficiencies in past mandated increases under their collective bargaining agreement.

The workers said management had proposed a ₱13 adjustment, which workers claim falls short of what is required under their agreement, and comes after what they describe as a cumulative wage gap over the past three years.

📸: Joshua Isaac Españo
